where src/render.ts file page

quote <link rel="help" href="${rel(here, 'guide/')}">

Because (Claude, not asked): it's a registered relation that means what this link is, so an agent finds the guide from any page without knowing phoropter's own names. It's in every page's head and header, and on the orientation's link. The profile lists it.

Chose: The guide is read from phoropter's files, and says when they're uncommitted

where src/guide.ts file page

quote return dirty ? `commit ${sha}, with uncommitted changes to the guide` : `commit ${sha}`;

Because (Claude, not asked): everything about the generated repository is read through git at a commit, but the guide describes the tool, so it comes from whatever phoropter is running. Reading it from git too would make an edited guide invisible until committed, which is the wrong surprise while writing one. Saying "with uncommitted changes" keeps the version line honest instead.
